What was once a place of happiness, joy and wholesome dairy goods has of late become dominated by a vile presence. Each morning Sarah wakes to find her crops destroyed, her cows cowering, and her loyal sheepdog looking... sheepish.<br><br>
She's had enough, but she thinks she's got the culprit on the trot. Can you help her track down... A Porcine of Interest?
